rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP, but then executed multiple order-changing actions without first confirming with the user, violating the confirm-before-write policy and the user’s stated preference to do one thing at a time. Specifically, it canceled orders (#W9373487 and #W5481803) and initiated a return for sneakers (#W7449508) without explicit confirmation. It also failed to provide the requested tracking number for the tablet or to address whether a refund/reorder was possible, nor did it escalate appropriately. The final message only mentions the sneaker return and omits confirmation or results for the cancellations. These issues constitute policy and outcome failures.
